title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
abstract: arXiv:2611.23946v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are widely trained in executable GUI environments. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices. We describe these choices along three dimensions: reward coverage, the goal-reaching trajectories the verifier rewards; data coverage, the application data the agent is exposed to beyond what the task reads or writes; and feature coverage, the application features beyond what the task uses. Existing works set each dimension on engineering grounds, but they do not measure its effect on training. How complete must an environment be to train a capable agent, and along which dimensions? translated_title: 训练一个有能力的GUI智能体需要环境有多完整？
translated_abstract: 图形用户界面（GUI）智能体通常在可执行的GUI环境中进行训练。为了降低成本、批量构建环境并减少人工投入，每项工作都会通过其环境构建选择舍弃部分环境内容。我们从三个维度来描述这些选择：奖励覆盖，即验证器所奖励的达成目标的轨迹；数据覆盖，即智能体接触到的超出任务读取或写入范围的应用数据；特征覆盖，即超出任务所使用的应用功能特征。现有工作基于工程考量来设定每个维度，但并未衡量其对训练效果的影响。那么，训练一个有能力的智能体，环境需要多完整？又需要在哪些维度上保持完整？在MobileGym中，我们分别调整每个维度，训练Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct模型，并在原始完整环境中评估每个策略。结果显示，只奖励单一参考路径的验证器会使成功率降低10.53个百分点……
tldr: 该论文提出MobileGym平台，首次系统研究了GUI训练环境在奖励覆盖、数据覆盖和特征覆盖三个维度上的完整性对智能体训练效果的影响，发现环境完整性的降低会显著损害智能体的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MobileGym to systematically study, for the first time, how environment completeness along three dimensions—reward coverage, data coverage, and feature coverage—affects GUI agent training, showing that reduced completeness significantly degrades agent performance.
